# Upstream PyMeshLab source reference

Source: https://github.com/cnr-isti-vclab/PyMeshLab
License: GNU GPL v3 (https://github.com/cnr-isti-vclab/PyMeshLab/blob/main/LICENSE)
Documentation: https://pymeshlab.readthedocs.io/

Official README and LICENSE were inspected from the GitHub repository during integration. The downloaded library binaries/full repository are not included in this archive: direct GitHub clone and PyPI installation could not complete in the current sandbox due to restricted networking. Use `scripts/get_official_pymeshlab_source.sh` if downloading full source in a networked environment; use pip to install the native Python extension for execution.

Blender's `bpy` scripts communicate with PyMeshLab through a local separate process. No third-party GPL source has been copied into the original MIT adapter.
